subject: Hyperscale AI — post-EdgeSummit discovery & next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@hyperscale.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Apr 28 2027 09:15 -0700
Subject: Hyperscale AI — post-EdgeSummit discovery & next steps

Hi Emma — great meeting you at EdgeSummit yesterday, really enjoyed the conversation about Gen-AI features for document ingestion and low-latency reranking. Quick recap from our chat and suggested next steps so we stay aligned:

- Key pain: unpredictable per-token costs at peak inference and tail latency above 300ms for 99th percentile
- What Hyperscale wants: sub-200ms p99 for 8k context+rerank pipeline, predictable monthly spend for bursty workloads
- Redwood fit: dedicated GPU pools + prefix caching + quantization options; our dedicated plan maps to steady baseline with burst capacity for peaks

Proposed next steps:
1) Tech sync: 30-min demo + Q&A so our infra engineers can see your sample payload and replicates (I linked my calendar below).
2) POC plan: 2-week pilot on a small dataset (we suggested 50k monthly tokens) — we'll provide test harness and an initial cost estimate.
3) Security: we'll share SOC2 scope and a short checklist; bring your security contact if helpful.

I attached my quick meeting notes (edge-meeting-notes.txt) and a one-pager for the POC scope (hyperscale-poc-1pager.pdf). If you want, Marissa (cc'd) can draft a mutual action plan after we confirm timing.

Calendly: https://cal.redwood.ai/connor/30min
Proposal preview: https://redwood.ai/proposal/HS-2027-0428

Would Thursday or Friday afternoon (PDT) work for the tech sync?

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Hey Connor — thanks for the notes and the clear plan. Friday afternoon works better for us (2pm PDT would be ideal). A couple quick questions ahead of the call so our team can prep:

- Ballpark pricing for a 2-week pilot with similar traffic to what we demo'd?
- Any constraints around PII in logs during the pilot? We need to map that to our compliance checklist.

I'll bring our infra lead and cc'd security to the call. See you Friday at 2pm if that still works.

Best,

Hi Emma — circling back to confirm our sync at Friday 2pm PDT and to share a quick pilot estimate so your team has something to reference during planning:

- Estimated pilot cost (2 weeks, test harness, dedicated 1x A100-equivalent): ~$6k–8k (depends on token volume during test).
- PII: we support redaction at ingestion and customer-controlled logging; we'll share the SOC2 artifact and our data-retention configuration during the call.

If the 2pm slot is tight, happy to shift to a shorter 20-minute run-through that focuses on integration and security. Marissa will join to cover onboarding and to draft the MAP after the call.

Quick ask: if priority has shifted since EdgeSummit, would you mind letting me know so we can tailor our next outreach? If now's not the right moment, we can queue this for your next budget cycle and I can send a lighter-touch eval plan.

Link to confirm: https://cal.redwood.ai/connor/30min

Thanks — Connor
